# `st_srid`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
st_srid(geo)
```

Returns the SRID of the input GEOGRAPHY or GEOMETRY value.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `st_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT st_srid(st_geogfromwkb(X'0101000000000000000000F03F0000000000000040'));
```

Result:

```text
4326
```

```sql
SELECT st_srid(st_geomfromwkb(X'0101000000000000000000F03F0000000000000040'));
```

Result:

```text
0
```

```sql
SELECT st_srid(NULL);
```

Result:

```text
NULL
```
